figures.finding: Pitcairn has no law that sets pay for film or stage work, nor any film fund: its ordinances, listed by the territory's government, include no employment, wages, film or culture ordinance (only one on trade unions and trade disputes), and otherwise English common law and statutes of general application apply as local circumstances permit.

value.law: Pitcairn Constitution s. 42: Governor's ordinances, UK legislation and Orders in Council extending to Pitcairn, and English common law and statutes of general application

figures.applies: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands (British Overseas Territory), all roles, as of the ordinance list's latest entry (5 May 2026).

sources.said: Pitcairn law comprises (a) laws (called "ordinances") made by the Governor, (b) United Kingdom legislation and Orders in Council extending to Pitcairn, and (c) the common law, rules of equity, and statutes of general application as in force in England for the time being, so far as local circumstances and the limits of local jurisdiction permit … ALPHABETICAL LIST OF ORDINANCES Adoption of Infants Annual Revision of Laws Apiaries Bail Births and Deaths Registration Children Commissions of Enquiry Coroners Ordinance 2011 Currency Dental and Medical Practitioners … Sexual Offences (Notification and Prevention) Social Welfare Benefits Summary Offences Trade Unions and Trade Disputes Victims of Offences Wills
